note: Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/ua-portable-vectors.mjs (src/ua.js, @noble/curves 2.4.0, @noble/post-quantum 0.7.1); never edit by hand. UA-8 portable registrations as typed EIP-712 records (typed-signing TS-D1 ... TS-D4): domain EIP712Domain(string name,string version) = ("SCaaS UA Portable", "1"), no chain id, verifying contract or salt (typed.*); typed(s) = keccak256(0x1901 | typed.domainSeparator | hashStruct(s)); no chain and no registry anywhere. KEM keys (CTR-UA-32): kemPk = scheme byte | key; kemScheme 1 = ML-KEM-1024 + X25519, 0x01 | ek (1,568 B) | X25519 pk (32 B) = kemPkLength bytes; scheme 2 (ML-KEM-1024 + HQC + X25519) is reserved and refused (UAKemScheme), as is every other scheme byte; an empty key or a key of another length than its scheme's is UAKemKeyLength. Digests: pqzKeyHash = keccak256(PQZ_KEY_GROUP | pqzKey) (keyHash of scheme 0x0142, not a plain keccak; the key is of a set's length, else UAKeyData); pqzPopHash = keccak256(pqzPop); kemRecordHash = hashStruct(UAKemRecord{ua, version, scheme = kemPk[0], kemPkHash = keccak256(kemPk)}) of the register key, always version 0 (owner 2026-10-31: register takes no KEM version), the zero record UAKemRecord{ua, 0, 0, 0} when there is none (a present record has scheme != 0: version 0 with scheme 0 is UAKemScheme); portableRecordDigest = typed(UAPortableRecord{ua, kind, pqzKeyHash, kem}) (kind = the registering kind, uint16); registrationDigest = typed(UARegistration{record, pqzPopHash = attrs.pqzPopHash}); popMessage = ua_msg(kind, PURPOSE_POP_V2, registrationDigest); pqzRegMessage = ua_msg(0x0142, PURPOSE_POP_V2, portableRecordDigest) (the R_REG message); kemRecords: structHash = hashStruct(UAKemRecord), digest = typed(UAKemRecord), signed as ua_msg(kind, PURPOSE_KEM, digest); PQZ key record (setPqzKey): pqzKeyDigest = typed(UAPqzKey{ua, pqzKeyHash}) (its R_REG message: ua_msg(0x0142, PURPOSE_PQZ_KEY, pqzKeyDigest)), recordDigest = typed(UAPqzKeyRecord{UAPqzKey{ua, pqzKeyHash}, pqzPopHash}), signed as ua_msg(kind, PURPOSE_PQZ_KEY, recordDigest). typedData = the eth_signTypedData_v4 JSON of the signed record (hashTypedData(typedData) = registrationDigest / digest / recordDigest). Absent attributes are empty / 0. PQZ key: set once per chain, by register or later by setPqzKey(ua, pqzKey, pqzPopHash, sig), which is accepted only while the registration has no PQZ key (UAPqzKeySet otherwise; holder rules as register). Client rule: one PQZ key per UA, ever (a UA that signs records for two PQZ keys can end with different keys on different chains). msig: a derived member signs memberDigest = keccak256(ua | message) of the portable message (popMessage, the KEM record message, the PQZ key record message) under member; a slot carries no key data. A code-less native EOA member (its own key only) signs the record's typed digest itself, typedDigest = registrationDigest / digest / recordDigest (what eth_signTypedData_v4 of typedData returns), 65-byte r | s | v, low-s, v in {27, 28}; EIP-191 personal_sign is refused (native-member-personal-sign). Only for PURPOSE_POP_V2, PURPOSE_KEM and PURPOSE_PQZ_KEY; every other purpose stays UAAuth (chain-bound EIP-712: CTR-MTX-14). A contract member answers ERC-1271 isValidSignature(typedDigest, sig) on each chain: portable only where that wallet exists with the same behaviour. Acceptance (CTR-UA-37): memberships[i] = acceptMembership(ua, MemberSig{index, [], sig}) of the member at slot index of the msig row msig: digest = typed(UAMembership{ua, member}), message = ua_msg(0x0120, PURPOSE_MEMBERSHIP, digest), memberDigest = keccak256(ua | message); a native member signs digest itself (ECDSA, or ERC-1271 over it), a derived member signs ua_msg(memberKind, member, memberDigest) under member. The same signature on every registry; no nonce. Typed arguments (typed-signing R1, TS-D10 ... TS-D12; the byte fields above stay): registrations[i].args = the named arguments of register(kind, keyData, attrs, pop, pqzPop) (a single key) or registerMsig(structure, attrs, pop, pqzPop) (an msig: structure = {threshold, members: [{kind, id, weight}]} assembled by the registry to keyData, pop = [{index, members, sig}] hashed as abi.encode(MemberSig[]); owner 2026-11-03: an msig stores keccak256 of it, popOf returns those 32 bytes, and per slot memberSigHashes[k] = {index, hash: keccak256(sig, or abi.encode(InnerSig[]) for an msig member)} = memberSigHashOf(ua, index), the bytes in that slot's UAMemberSig), with attrs = {pqzKey, pqzPopHash, kem: KemKey{scheme, mlkemEk, x25519} (kemPk = scheme | mlkemEk | x25519, the empty key = none), kemPkHash}; registrations[i].kemCommit (KEM rows) = the same registration with the KEM record's hash only (kem = {scheme, 0x, 0}, kemPkHash = keccak256(kemPk); the same pop: the record words are equal) and its fill = setKemKey(ua, 0, kem, sig = UASig{0x, 0x, []}), open to anyone (owner 2026-10-31: only when the full key does not fit one transaction; every version write-once); kemRecords[i].args = setKemKey(ua, version, kem, sig) and pqzKeyRecords[i].args = setPqzKey(ua, pqzKey, pqzPopHash, sig) with sig = UASig{keyData, signature, members} (a single key: signature = sig; an msig: members, never keyData). attrs.kemVersion is gone (R1). typed-signing R1b (TS-D13): the webauthn-p256 row's args = registerWebAuthn(key = {x, y, rpIdHash}, attrs, pop, pqzPop), the registry assembling keyData = x | y | rpIdHash (register(0x0100, ...) is refused); MuSig2 / FROST keys register by registerMuSig2 / registerFrost(kind, key, attrs, pop, pqzPop) (clientkeys typedKey; no row here). Rows: registrations[i] = register(kind, keyData, attrs, pop, pqzPop); kemRecords[i] = setKemKey(ua, version, kemPk, sig) (id = name/vN, versions 1-3, each its own key; version 0 is the registration's key, stored by register, never by setKemKey: UAKemVersion; every version is write-once); pqzKeyRecords[i] = setPqzKey(ua, 0, pqzKey, pqzPopHash, sig) (group 3g: version 0) for a UA registered without a PQZ key (its proof bytes for storePqzPop: the set's filler, registrations "mldsa65/<set>".pqzPop). pqzPop rows are filler of a real R_REG proof's length per set, not proofs. Group 3g (spec 2026-11-06-pqz-key-versions, KV-1, KV-2): pqzKeyVersions[i] = setPqzKey(ua, version, pqzKey, pqzPopHash, sig) for version 1, then 2, after the UA's pqzKeyRecords row (version 0), each version its own key and proof filler (pqzPop, for storePqzPop(ua, version, pqzPop)): sig over uaMessage(kind, PURPOSE_PQZ_KEY, recordDigest), recordDigest = typed(UAPqzKeyVersionRecord{ua, version, pqzKeyHash, pqzPopHash}), versionDigest = typed(UAPqzKeyVersion{ua, version, pqzKeyHash}) and pqzRegMessage = uaMessage(0x0142, PURPOSE_PQZ_KEY, versionDigest) (the R_REG message). Version 0 keeps UAPqzKey / UAPqzKeyRecord. pqzKeyVersionNegatives: setPqzKey of the pqzKeyVersions row mutation.row with mutation.set replaced, on the state where exactly the versions mutation.stored of that UA are stored (0: its pqzKeyRecords row), refused with error. negatives: mutation.row names a row of registrations (entry register, storePqzPop, requireAuthorized), kemRecords by id (setKemKey) or pqzKeyRecords (setPqzKey); mutation.set replaces fields (attrs.<field>, pqzPop, pop, ua, sig, pqzPopHash, purposeTag, digest, auth); mutation.registerWith gives the register call that precedes a storePqzPop row; mutation.otherKind (record-kind-mismatch) is the kind the pop's record names instead of the row's. Attribute checks run before the PoP; error is the registry's. A proof hash of keccak256("") (an empty proof) is UAPqzPopHash wherever a proof hash is signed, and storePqzPop refuses empty proof bytes.

negatives.name: msig-pop-not-minimal
negatives.why: A stored msig signature (pop v2, KEM record, PQZ key record) is refused unless every slot is necessary: with T = the slots' total weight and N the threshold, T >= N and T - weight(i) < N for every slot (owner 2026-10-31). This 2-of-(1, 2) msig over the registered mldsa65#1 and mldsa65#2 (the lower id weight 1) is signed by both slots: every member signature verifies and the old rule accepts it (1, then 3 >= 2), but the weight-2 slot alone reaches the threshold. Digest-only readers skip rule msig-minimal. lightestInMiddle: the same rule when the lightest slot is not the first: 5-of-(2, 1, 3) by index over mldsa65, #1 and #2, all three signed: T - weight(1) = 5, so the weight-1 slot is not necessary, while T - weight(0) = 4 would pass a check of the first slot alone.
